build_sampler: build a DensePoseCSEBaseSampler with config, embedder, and count_per_class to sample DensePose data from predictions
sample_densepose_data: sample DensePoseDataRelative from estimation results using the _sample method with an instance and bounding box
produce_mask_and_results: produce a segmentation mask and CSE embeddings from a DensePose prediction instance and bounding box
resample_mask: resample the coarse segmentation output to a 256x256 int64 segmentation annotation tensor
review_class: review the DensePoseCSEBaseSampler class and its sampling logic for DensePose CSE embedding predictions
